title: After The Blackout, Ben Was NICE
premise: In this town a blackout can swap anyone sitting alone in the dark with another version of themselves, so families sit together with flashlights and check each other after. My big brother Ben and I haven't been nice to each other in three years, and after Tuesday's blackout he makes me a sandwich with the crusts cut off.
twist: Ben didn't swap. I did: I was the one alone in the dark on Tuesday, and I woke in the house where my brother and I never stopped being friends. Swapped back at the next blackout, my real Ben says the other me was nice all week, so I make him the sandwich, and now he's sure I'm not his.
world: One summer week in a suburban house: a sunny living room with a big window, a mantel, a couch that is mustard in my version and teal in this one, a hall of photos, my bedroom with a bedside clock, a street of painted houses with porches that goes dark and lights up.
